text.en:
The following essential commodity shall not
be sold at more than the maximum selling prices for
importers, wholesalers. and retailers set opposite each:
FOODSTUFF (IMPORTED)
Without 17 per cent Special Excise Tax on Foreign Exchange
Importer's Wholesaler's Retailer's
CANNED MEAT
Corned Beef
Royal Brand ....
SEc. 2. The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.
SEc. 3. This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of January, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
